'''Death-sleep''' was a term used by the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] to describe the state of hibernation that their [[Warrior (Charon)|warriors]] underwent. On the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Desolate]]'', Charon [[Soldier|warriors]] slumbered in the [[chamber of sleep]].
